newsitem.title: GERMANY: Eduscho to hike coffee price on June 30.
newsitem.headline: Eduscho to hike coffee price on June 30.

text.p: Germany's Eduscho on Thursday announced it would raise retail coffee prices of most of its products by 0.50 marks per 500-gram packet with effect from June 30.
The roaster cited persistently higher raw materials prices, tightness in high quality washed arabicas and dollar strength versus the mark.
Prices after the increase on June 30 would range between 8.99 marks and 10.49 marks for the most expensive product, GALA, Eduscho said.
Roaster Tchibo on June 12 announced a price hike of the same extent, which will take effect on June 26.
